note: Primitive campsites in bottomland timber at a Gasconade River boat ramp, in two groups: seven along the gravel entrance road before the ramp lot (short angled gravel spurs on the south side of the road), and four just south of the lot beside the privy, about 40 m from the river bank through the trees. The ramp lot itself is parking. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 11 primitive campsites (area page), drawn on the map as '7 Sites' on the entrance road and '4 Sites' south of the ramp lot, with a privy; 5 GIS points. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; site count and privy written; phone matches; pin is on a camping point. Stored RIVERFRONT is not supported: no site is on an open apron - flagged as a lead down to riverview.
flags: INCLUSION (stays - mapped individual campsites, not the lot): area page 'This area has 11 primitive campsites and a boat ramp.', 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. No brochure. The map (04/10) labels a Primitive Camping Area symbol '7 Sites' on the south side of the gravel entrance road and another '4 Sites' south of the lot, which it labels 'Parking', with the Privy and Disabled Accessible symbols between; the legend also lists Boat Ramp. GIS layer 27 has five 'Primitive Camping Area' points: 622, 623, 624 (38.39377,-91.82202 / 38.39380,-91.82190 / 38.39385,-91.82181) on the entrance road, 410 (38.39366,-91.82109, the stored pin) at the lot's north-west corner where the road enters it, and 315 (38.39302,-91.82089) south of the lot. On the leaf-off frames: three or four short angled gravel pull-in spurs are visible on the south side of the road near points 622-624, under timber; south of the lot a privy and a spot occupied by a travel trailer and a vehicle at point 315.

WATERFRONT LEAD DOWN (stored riverfront; stored evidence 'lot runs out to the Osage/Missouri bank, open sand/gravel apron to the water' describes the RAMP LOT, and the river is the Gasconade). Per GIS point, distance to the water and what lies between (imagery estimates, 0.33 and 0.14 m/px): 622 about 165 m, 623 about 155 m, 624 about 150 m - bottomland timber and then the whole ramp lot between; 410 about 80 m - the ramp lot and ramp between; 315 about 41 m - a band of bottomland timber about 35 m deep (bare in this frame, open understorey), no road or lot between, the ramp 45 m to the north-east and not in the way. Spots on an open apron within ~50 m: NONE. The four south sites are the only ones within 50 m and they are behind trees; leaf-off the river shows plainly through them. So riverfront is not supported; riverview is supported for the four south sites on the leaf-off frame (no official photos to confirm it in leaf). Same pattern as Pointers Creek and Payne Landing: down to riverview.
LOT RULE: does not arise - MDC maps the sites as their own spots beside, not on, the ramp lot ('Parking').
PIN: stored 38.39366,-91.82109 is GIS point 410 at the lot's north-west corner, between the two groups (7 sites 60-80 m west, 4 sites 75 m south-east). Left there.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the area page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.

ACCESS: 'From Linn, take Highway 89 south 7 miles to the access.' A gravel road about 400 m from Highway 89 through the bottom; no ford or limit. River bottom - floods with the Gasconade; no closure posted now.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands; nothing dates the camping.
